english.notes: Computer Engineering is 100% English with a compulsory ING 150 English preparatory programme (ydyo.hacettepe.edu.tr/en/menu/foreign_language_preparatory_requir-181). No admission minimum or prep-exemption score found on a readable page: the international office site internationalstudents.hacettepe.edu.tr is a JavaScript app (no text without scripts; /api/ is robots-disallowed), and the equivalence table PDF sits on fs.hacettepe.edu.tr, whose robots.txt disallows everything (not used).

value.description: No school-grade threshold; TR-YÖS >= 400/500 or SAT I (EBRW+Math) >= 1200 for bachelor programmes; GCE A Level: average at least C with 3 A Levels (or 2 A + 1 AS) in related subjects.

gpa.quote: TR-YÖS 500 puan üzerinden en az 400 puan
gpa.notes: Test-score threshold (TR-YÖS / SAT). Source is the university directive for admission from abroad (Senate, file dated 2023-05-25), not a 2027 call. The SAT minimum (1200) is in the same table: 'en az 1200 puan'.

deadline.notes: The 2026-2027 international application calendar is only on internationalstudents.hacettepe.edu.tr (JavaScript app, unreadable); oidb.hacettepe.edu.tr only says 'Hacettepe University 2026–2027 International Student Applications are ongoing.' No 2027 cycle found.

tuition.notes: International fee page is on the JavaScript app. oidb.hacettepe.edu.tr/en/update_on_tuition_fees-665 only cites an Executive Board decision of 2024-08-08 (no amounts in text). Search results showed a 2024-2025 faculty table (Engineering 250,254 TRY) on internationalstudent2.hacettepe.edu.tr, which this container could not reach (proxy 502); stale cycle in any case.

scholarship_exists.notes: No university scholarship for incoming international bachelor students found on a readable official page; oidb 'Burslar' lists third-party foundation awards only.
